Welcome To Family Day Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JENTOBELLO has gone close on several occasions already and can finally make amends here at the expense of Fine Thing.

  1. JENTOBELLO
  2. FINE THING
  3. MR RAMOON (IRE)

races.name: Percy's Racing Dream Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
EVALUATION certainly comes with risks attached, but he looked to be crying out for this longer trip when running well in stronger events last year, so he's awarded the vote. Course specialist Heart Above has to be high on the shortlist, while Ballynoe Boy will be of firm interest if taking up this engagement after getting a hat-trick up at Hexham on Friday.

  1. EVALUATION
  2. HEART ABOVE
  3. BALLYNOE BOY (IRE)

races.name: Justin & Susan Greig Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TUPPENCE is the pick at the weights and is hard to oppose. Her stablemate Luna Grace may prove next best.

  1. TUPPENCE (FR)
  2. LUNA GRACE
  3. BROSNA TOWN (IRE)

races.name: NSPCC School Service Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ICE JET opened his account over fences in emphatic fashion last time and is taken to follow up, with his 4-y-o allowance again looking a massive help. Last year’s placed pair, Traprain Law and northern stalwart Tommy’s Oscar, look the chief dangers.

  1. ICE JET (IRE)
  2. TRAPRAIN LAW (FR)
  3. TOMMY'S OSCAR (IRE)

races.name: Scottish Racing Academy Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FAIRLAWN SKIPPER looked a good prospect when going in at the first time of asking over fences here last month and with this return to further a plus he is fancied to make light of a 7 lb rise in the weights. Upfordebate has really taken to the larger obstacles too and should ensure Mickey Bowen's promising sort doesn't have things all his own way.

  1. FAIRLAWN SKIPPER
  2. UPFORDEBATE (IRE)
  3. SIR CARNEGIE (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV Now Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A few of these arrive with a question mark against them and this looks a good opportunity for Stuart Coltherd's mare MY MY MY DELILAH to capitalise on a handy-looking mark and gain a first success under Rules. Valtteri Its James could emerge as the main danger reverted to hurdles after a break, although Lone Star is also weighted to have a say.

  1. MY MY MY DELILAH
  2. VALTTERI ITS JAMES (IRE)
  3. LONE STAR

races.name: F Ball Stick With It Chasing Excellence Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
COUNTRY MILE has yet to have a clear shot at racing but he's looked pretty talented on occasions and with his year-long absence no real concern given the yard he represents, he can get off the mark over fences. This trip is surely on the sharp side for O'Moore Park so chase debutant The Gray Ghost may chase the selection home.

  1. COUNTRY MILE (IRE)
  2. THE GRAY GHOST (IRE)
  3. O'MOORE PARK (IRE)

races.name: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
With the Twiston-Davies stable hitting form in recent weeks, GENTLE OCEAN, who was runner-up in an Irish point during the winter, may well be the answer on Rules debut. A Chara will go very close if repeating her Southwell run, while In The Trenches may have more to offer for Jennie Candlish.

  1. GENTLE OCEAN (IRE)
  2. A CHARA
  3. IN THE TRENCHES

races.name: F Ball 140th Anniversary Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
An expensive purchase out of Irish bumpers prior to last season, GOVERNORS ROCK may well be good enough to make a successful start over hurdles. Fairly useful Flat recruit Analogical stands out as the danger, while any support for point winner Shah is likely to be telling.

  1. GOVERNORS ROCK (IRE)
  2. ANALOGICAL
  3. SHAH (FR)

races.name: F Ball 140th Anniversary Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
The Twiston-Davies yard couldn't be going much better at present so CURRENT EDITION is selected to continue their hot streak and make a winning return having gone down by a nose first time up in this discipline back in the spring. Sytadel bumped into a subsequent winner starting out for this yard recently, so he looks an obvious danger, with stable-switcher Larzac rounding off the shortlist.

  1. CURRENT EDITION (IRE)
  2. SYTADEL (FR)
  3. LARZAC (FR)

races.name: F Ball Established 1886 Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
In an open-looking handicap, the vote goes to ERNEST GRAY, who proved at least as good as ever when a comprehensive winner at Bangor last time. Smooth-travelling Divalabother will be ridden cold and could run into a place, with last year's winner Roger Pol likely to be thereabouts if on another going day.

  1. ERNEST GRAY (IRE)
  2. DIVILABOTHER (IRE)
  3. ROGER POL (IRE)

races.name: F Ball Yellow Bucket Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Handicap debutant ARCON could be the answer to a tricky puzzle. Raging Al may well have a big say if settling on his seasonal reappearance, with Lucky Sevens and Chico Magnifica respected for excellent yards.

  1. ARCON (GER)
  2. RAGING AL (IRE)
  3. LUCKY SEVENS

races.name: F Ball Centre Of Excellence Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but TROPICAL TALENT looked the likely winner until hitting the last at Sedgefield last time and is weighted to make amends here. Holy Legend is enjoying a fine time of it this season and rates the chief threat in his bid for a fourth success from his last 5 outings, while chasing newcomer Playful Fox and the selection's stablemate Dexter can also have a say in this competitive handicap.

  1. TROPICAL TALENT
  2. HOLY LEGEND
  3. PLAYFUL FOX (FR)

races.name: QuinnBet Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
BETTER OFF ALONE comes with risks attached but took a step forward on his return when third at Worcester and can gain a first success off a 2 lb lower mark at the chief expense of C&D scorer Jo Arengeot Bey AA. Fane Court could also have a say given a second try over fences in this thin handicap.

  1. BETTER OFF ALONE (IRE)
  2. JO ARENGEOT BEY AA (FR)
  3. FANE COURT (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Not a strong maiden by any means and this could be the day that ASTELIA finally gets off the mark having gained the reputation of being a serial bridesmaid. Mastertown Miss got back on track at Ballinrobe recently in a first-time hood, she could give the selection most to think about. Katie Can't Count can edge out Run For Power for third.

  1. ASTELIA (IRE)
  2. MASTERTOWN MISS (IRE)
  3. KATIE CAN'T COUNT (IRE)

races.name: Seamus Weldon John Deere Dealer Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
COLIN’S FRIEND improved in a competitive handicap on stable debut at Galway last time and, with further progress likely, he looks worth chancing in an ordinary affair. The Border Boy is well treated at present and looked set to go close when making a last-flight error here last month, so rates the main danger, while Granlahan and Kingdom Calling are also respected.

  1. COLIN'S FRIEND (IRE)
  2. THE BORDER BOY (IRE)
  3. GRANLAHAN (IRE)

races.name: Gleneagle Arena Killarney Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for most of these, but LIPS FREEDOM resumed his progress when going down narrowly at Navan recently so Andrew Kinirons' 6-y-o earns the tentative nod returned to novice company. Cocofred can't have been right on his handicap debut, so he's worth another chance to get back on the up here, with Firebrand and Celtic Alliance taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. LIPS FREEDOM (GER)
  2. COCOFRED (IRE)
  3. FIREBRAND (GER)

races.name: QuinnBet Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
TEDWORTH got back on track last time and looks capable of adding to his sole success if coping with the quick turnaround. Ballyminnion Boy saw things out with more purpose last time and rates the main danger, while James The Brave is well treated on his previous chase win so is dangerous if fully wound up for this.

  1. TEDWORTH (IRE)
  2. BALLYMINNION BOY (IRE)
  3. JAMES THE BRAVE (IRE)

races.name: Carry Out Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
STONEYFORD LADY looked a big threat when unseating her rider at Ballinrobe last month so Henry de Bromhead's mare gets the nod to make amends provided she's none the worse from that spill. Kilbrin Rocco shaped well from his lower hurdling mark at Listowel recently and if translating that form back to chasing, he looks a big threat with Jack Kennedy booked. The frustrating Presenting Lad looks best of the rest.

  1. STONEYFORD LADY (IRE)
  2. KILBRIN ROCCO (IRE)
  3. PRESENTING LAD (IRE)

races.name: O'Donoghue Ring Collection Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
TIME IS A THIEF looks an interesting type for the excellent Henry de Bromhead yard and he gets the nod over fellow chasing debutant Stede Bonnet. It's still relatively early days over fences for Impero, who isn't taken lightly.

  1. TIME IS A THIEF (IRE)
  2. STEDE BONNET (IRE)
  3. IMPERO (IRE)

races.name: Quills Menswear Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
KILKEE BAY gets the nod over Cullenwaine in a tricky finale. Chasing debutants Keep Em Quite and Backinabit also appeal, especially if supported.

  1. KILKEE BAY (IRE)
  2. CULLENWAINE (IRE)
  3. KEEP EM QUITE (IRE)

races.name: Final Furlong Podcast With 1xBet.ie Irish European Breeders Fund Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
The market should reveal plenty here but the vote goes to Aidan O'Brien's newcomer SWEETLY, who is a sister to the stable's Irish Derby hero Benvenuto Cellini no less, and looks a very interesting proposition on her first go on the racecourse. Both Pirate Anne Bonny and Little Darling shaped well on their respective debuts at Naas and Leopardstown and can also have a say, while the selection's stablemate Petticoat Bay is another debutante to note.

  1. SWEETLY (USA)
  2. PIRATE ANNE BONNY (IRE)
  3. LITTLE DARLING (IRE)

races.name: Bermingham Cameras Irish European Breeders Fund (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
HMAS PERTH sets a clear standard on the form of his Doncaster second and he looks the obvious pick to go one place better. Stablemate Paraguay is much respected on debut, with Cracks And Sparks also on the shortlist.

  1. HMAS PERTH (USA)
  2. PARAGUAY (USA)
  3. CRACKS AND SPARKS

races.name: Coolmore Sioux Nation Concorde Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
The improving LOUGHREA can take the step up into listed company in his stride and complete the 4-timer. The likeable Big Gossey looks set to add another positive effort at this track to his record and can pose the biggest threat ahead of Carolina Jetstream.

  1. LOUGHREA (IRE)
  2. BIG GOSSEY (IRE)
  3. CAROLINA JETSTREAM

races.name: 1xBet.ie Proud Supporters Of Irish Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
IAMIMMACULATE signalled he is ready to gain a first success for his current yard when runner-up at Listowel last time and looks the way to go here off a still handy-looking mark. Truth Be Told rates a big threat though on the back of a promising sixth in a big-field Leopardstown handicap last time, while Majestic King and Johnny Soda can also play a prominent role.

  1. IAMIMMACULATE (IRE)
  2. TRUTH BE TOLD (IRE)
  3. MAJESTIC KING (IRE)

races.name: Hailey Equine Irish European Breeders Fund Brigid's Pastures Stakes (Fillies' Listed)
races.verdict:
Any more rain wouldn't go amiss but it's not a necessity for last year's winner CARLA RIDGE who stands out on the ratings. Dancing Saxon has been consistent this season and should give another good account, with Royal Bay Cen is another who can be in the mix providing this doesn't come too soon after her run last week.

  1. CARLA RIDGE (IRE)
  2. DANCING SAXON (IRE)
  3. ROYAL BAY CEN (IRE)

races.name: Business Plus Handicap
races.verdict:
A most competitive sprint, with the vote going to APACHE OUTLAW, whose latest efforts at 7f suggest he might prove very well suited by a big-field at this trip. Jon Riggens also arrives in good form and is also shortlisted, with I Bid You Ajou, Gerrit's Gem, Apothic Red and Irish Rumour others to merit serious consideration.

  1. APACHE OUTLAW (IRE)
  2. JON RIGGENS (IRE)
  3. I BID YOU AJOU (FR)

races.name: Holden Plant Rentals Lady Riders Classic (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict:
REST YOUR MIND has few miles on the clock but should be suited by the extra distance and can double her tally at the expense of last year's winner Alfalfa. Whimsy and It's Good To Talk are also others to consider.

  1. REST YOUR MIND (IRE)
  2. ALFALFA (IRE)
  3. WHIMSY

races.name: 1xBet.ie Proud Partners Of Irish Sport Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but HIGHBURY SEE SEE is taken to build on an unlucky-in-running second at Listowel last time to follow up his victory in this event 12 months ago. Veteran Loingseoir bagged this prize twice prior to that and heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Blue Blue Moon and Lady Arwen can also have a say in this highly competitive event.

  1. HIGHBURY SEE SEE (IRE)
  2. LOINGSEOIR (IRE)
  3. BLUE BLUE MOON (IRE)
